uploadHint: Drop an image here, choose a file, or paste from your clipboard.
formatsHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and other browser-supported images. Animated images export as a still frame.
noSelection: Select a region to adjust it, or draw a new one.
drawHint: Drag on the image to cover an area.
brushHint: Paint over the area you want to hide.
selectHint: Drag to move. Use the corner to resize and the top handle to rotate.
privacyTip: For sensitive text, use an opaque solid color. Blur and mosaic are visual effects and may leave information recognizable.
exportHint: Original resolution. Redactions are merged into the image pixels; source metadata is not copied.
imageError: This image could not be opened. Try a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file.
exportError: The image could not be exported. Please try again.
copyError: Clipboard access is unavailable. Download the image instead.
shortcuts: Shortcuts: V select · R rectangle · E ellipse · B brush · Delete remove · Ctrl/⌘ Z undo · Shift Ctrl/⌘ Z redo · Arrow keys move (Shift for larger steps).
howDescription: Open an image, choose a style, and draw over private information. Select any region to move, resize, rotate, or change its effect. Download the finished image when you are ready.
exportNote: Check the exported image before sharing. Choose PNG for crisp screenshots; JPEG uses a white background for transparency.
